hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; nvm_sh="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh"; [ -s "$nvm_sh" ] && { . "$nvm_sh" && nvm use --silent; } >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm -s product:pull --if-stale 2>/dev/null || echo 'warning: .product-docs/ not refreshed (needs Node 24 from .nvmrc), run pnpm product:pull'
